document: Universal Mobile Control — Audited Batch Chronology

source_of_truth.rule: Current source determines implementation facts. README determines historical test claims. Conflicts are preserved and explicitly marked for retest.

events: Accessibility-based phone controller selected.
Termux/MCP -> local HTTP bridge -> AccessibilityService architecture defined.
Screen observation planned through Accessibility UI tree, screenshot and ML Kit OCR.
Tap, swipe, Back and text entry planned.
MainActivity and VisionAccessibilityService implemented.
Local bridge listens on 127.0.0.1:8765.
UI nodes expose text, description, bounds and state.
Latin and Devanagari OCR implemented.
UniversalMobileControl-debug.apk produced.
Version recorded as 0.1.0 / Vision Engine MVP.
Gradle 8.13 under Termux recorded in project history.
chronology.limitation: Exact APK hash and exact installed revision were not recorded.

events: Historical screen/UI observation used 1080x2400.
Accessibility and OCR data were used to locate controls.
chronology.correction: 1080x2400 is historical evidence, not a fixed device constant.

events: Current source exposes /health, /screen, /scan, /action/start, /action/stop, /action/status, /tap, /swipe, /back and /type.
/home is not implemented.
/screen returns cached latestJson.
/scan starts an asynchronous scan and Action Mode.
HTTP response is always 200 even for application-level errors.
Editable 'Ask anything' node was found around 313,1865 to 1049,1957.
Tap around 680,1910 was dispatched.
Keyboard/focus change was not independently confirmed.
chronology.correction: Dispatch acceptance is not successful target activation.

events: Old request used start_x/start_y/end_x/end_y and failed because x1 was missing.
Current source expects x1,y1,x2,y2 and optional duration.
Back was user-confirmed working.
/home historically returned unknown endpoint.
A coordinate tap near Android navigation was not treated as proof of a /home API.
tapAt and swipeFromTo use GestureResultCallback.
CountDownLatch and AtomicReference distinguish completed, cancelled and timeout outcomes.
Tap waits up to 3 seconds; swipe waits up to 6 seconds.
chronology.audit_note: Callback timeout proves only that completion/cancellation was not observed within the wait window; it does not alone prove that no physical gesture occurred.

events: HandlerThread UMC-GestureCallbacks is created in onServiceConnected.
gestureCallbackHandler is passed to dispatchGesture.
The callback thread is quit in onDestroy.
canPerformGestures=true.
canRetrieveWindowContent=true.
canTakeScreenshot=true.
Interactive-window, view-id and include-not-important-views flags enabled.
chronology.correction: Configuration does not prove callback delivery or target UI change.

events: Recorded tap retest returned tap callback timeout.
Recorded swipe retest returned swipe callback timeout.
possible_causes: Current APK may not have been installed/restarted.
Accessibility service may still be running an older revision.
Gesture callback delivery may still be failing.
Disable/re-enable service cycle may be required.

events: README records Android Home -> app drawer -> native YouTube -> search -> Tum Hi Ho -> ad Skip -> playback verification.
Final state reportedly showed song title, T-Series channel, lyrics, Pause control and approximately 4–5 seconds elapsed of a 4:27 video.
chronology.correction: Retain as historical evidence, but do not use it as proof of the currently installed revision.

events: Action Mode starts a scan immediately and schedules another scan every 3000 ms.
tapAt and swipeFromTo call startActionMode before dispatching the gesture.
This means a vision refresh can run before and during the requested gesture.
No in-flight scan lock prevents overlapping screenshot/OCR work.
chronology.correction: Separate action dispatch from verification refresh and add a single-flight scan guard.

events: Gesture callback HandlerThread is explicitly stopped in onDestroy.
The single-thread OCR executor is created as a field but is not explicitly shut down in onDestroy.
The local bridge thread is daemonized but has no explicit service-lifecycle stop mechanism.
chronology.correction: Add deterministic executor shutdown and a bridge stop mechanism tied to service destruction.

audit_findings.finding: Tap/swipe callback completion is not currently proven by the latest recorded runtime tests.
audit_findings.correction: Require callback completion/cancellation plus fresh post-action UI verification before marking PASS.

audit_findings.finding: Historical README contains a native YouTube PASS while current source/runtime records still include gesture callback timeouts.
audit_findings.correction: Keep the historical PASS, but mark current-build regression as RETEST_REQUIRED.

audit_findings.finding: Action Mode and manual scan requests can overlap screenshot/OCR pipelines.
audit_findings.correction: Implement a single-flight scan guard or serialized scan queue.

audit_findings.finding: Tap/swipe start Action Mode before dispatching the gesture.
audit_findings.correction: Dispatch the action first; perform verification scan after the gesture result and UI settling delay.

audit_findings.finding: A new Latin and Devanagari recognizer is created for every scan.
audit_findings.correction: Reuse service-lifetime recognizers and close them in onDestroy.

audit_findings.finding: onAccessibilityEvent is empty, so UI changes do not directly invalidate cached state.
audit_findings.correction: Optionally use relevant accessibility events to trigger cache invalidation or a controlled refresh.
Do not list Home as a bridge endpoint until GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME is implemented and tested.

audit_findings.finding: APK artifact timestamp does not prove installed service provenance.
audit_findings.correction: Install exact APK, disable/re-enable Accessibility Service, and expose build/version provenance through a diagnostic endpoint.
Call executor.shutdownNow() or an equivalent controlled shutdown from onDestroy.

audit_findings.finding: Bridge lifecycle is not explicitly tied to service destruction.
audit_findings.correction: Keep a ServerSocket/thread reference and close/interupt it in onDestroy.

corrected_truth_table./tap: Implemented; latest recorded callback behavior requires retest.
corrected_truth_table./swipe: Implemented; latest recorded callback behavior requires retest.
corrected_truth_table./type: Implemented through focused editable AccessibilityNodeInfo; current runtime effect not independently verified in this audit.
corrected_truth_table.HTTP_200: Not sufficient proof of action success.

verification_protocol.level_4: Fresh post-action scan proves the intended UI state.
verification_protocol.final_rule: Only level 4 counts as a fully verified phone action.

confirmed: Current Accessibility architecture and local bridge source are present.
Gesture capability and dedicated callback HandlerThread are configured.
UI-tree and OCR screen observation are implemented.
Back implementation exists and was user-confirmed in an earlier test.
Historical native YouTube playback was documented.
not_currently_proven: Reliable tap completion in the currently installed runtime.
Reliable swipe completion in the currently installed runtime.
Current APK/service provenance for the historical YouTube PASS.
next_validation_gate: Run fresh pre-state -> action -> callback -> post-state tests.
Only then promote tap/swipe from RETEST_REQUIRED to PASS.
